# Your account

You can change your delivery address until the order is packed.
Order history is kept for three years.

# Caring for your kettle

Descale your kettle once a month in hard-water areas.
Never immerse the base in water.

# Contact us

The help desk answers messages within one working day.
Please include your order number in every message.

# Delivery

Orders placed before noon are packed the same day.
Standard delivery takes two to four working days.

# Payment

We accept cards and bank transfer.
Your card is charged when the order is packed.

# Paid repairs

A kettle fault outside the warranty is fixed with a paid repair.
A courier collects the appliance and returns it repaired.

# Replacements

A kettle fault covered by the warranty is fixed with a free replacement.
You keep the faulty appliance until the replacement arrives.

# Returns

You can return an unused item within 30 days of delivery.
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 working days.

# Warranty

Every Fernhollow kettle, toaster and mixer is covered for 12 months from the date of delivery.
The warranty covers manufacturing faults, not accidental damage.

To make a claim, have your order number ready.
